description: Largest token transfers (whale movements) on Base in the last minutes to hour: the biggest ERC-20 Transfer events of a token over a window of up to 1,000 blocks with amount, sender, receiver and transaction hash, filtered by a minimum amount (token=0x..., min_amount, blocks=400, count=20). For trading and risk agents watching large flows. Pay per call $0.02 USDC on Base via x402.

min_amount.description: minimum transfer size in tokens, default 0

token.description: ERC-20 token address on Base, e.g. 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006 (WETH); if omitted, the WETH example is answered

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment (X-PAYMENT header value); omit on the first call to receive the price and payment requirements
